p: LORD hear thee in the day: By this kings are also admonished to call to God in their affairs.
name of the God of Jacob: The virtue, power and grace of God.
accept thy burnt sacrifice: In token that they are acceptable to him.
salvation: Granted to the king in whose wealth our happiness stands.
know I that the LORD saveth: The Church feels that God had heard their petition.
holy heaven with the saving strength: As by the visible sanctuary God's familiarity appeared toward his people, so by the heavenly is meant his power and majesty.
They are brought down and fallen: The worldlings who do not put their trust in God alone.
let the king hear us when: Let the king be able to deliver us by your strength, when we seek him for help.
